praesumptōrĭus , a, um, adj. praesumptor,
I.presumptuous (eccl. Lat.), Aug. Collat. c. Maxim, 13.—Hence, praesump-tōrĭē , adv., boldly, confidently, presumptuously: “praesumptorie aliquid elocutus,” Tert. adv. Marc. 4, 41 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
